sanity_selection: First query by existing file order for each declared style, selected without inspecting rankings
scope: technical indexing/sanity only; no effectiveness metrics

method_parameters.fit_scope: 371 serialized corpus chunks only; never fit queries
method_parameters.name: TF-IDF + cosine
method_parameters.score: exact cosine; dot of L2-normalized sparse query/corpus vectors
method_parameters.tokenizer: lexical.token_pattern with re.findall; custom tokenizer; token_pattern=None in TfidfVectorizer

normalization_rules.normalization: serialization normalization, then casefold and U+2019 apostrophe to ASCII apostrophe

method_parameters.construction: pretokenized lists; tokenizer=None to avoid multiprocessing
method_parameters.eligible_scores: strictly greater than zero; discard zero and negative scores before rank assignment
method_parameters.idf: ln((N-df+0.5)/(df+0.5)); negative IDF replaced with epsilon*mean_raw_IDF
method_parameters.idf_safety: log mean_raw_IDF; fail pre-evaluation review if <=0; do not silently change variant
method_parameters.name: BM25Okapi
method_parameters.query_tf: sum once per token occurrence, per rank_bm25 get_scores
method_parameters.score: get_scores; explicit ranking.sort; do not use get_top_n default sorting
method_parameters.tokenizer: same lexical unigram tokens as R1

normalization_rules.normalization: serialization normalization, then casefold and U+2019 apostrophe to ASCII apostrophe
